name: dev-gh-list-workflow-runs
why: Listing runs, as the use names.

job.purpose: gh run list and gh run rerun --failed for acme/web: check CI on my PR and rerun failed jobs

statements: allow read on workflow run in repository "acme/web"
allow read on workflow job in repository "acme/web"
allow rerun on workflow run in repository "acme/web"

definitions.rerun: Re-run a workflow run's failed jobs: POST .../actions/runs/<id>/rerun-failed-jobs.
definitions.workflow job: A job of a GitHub Actions workflow run, its log included.
